question: Does a real complementary view improve building-footprint loss over a matched redundant view, for both opposite anchor directions?
estimand: Exploratory total-view benchmark benefit; no PSF mechanism, causal isolation, acquisition-policy novelty, or cross-sensor claim.

input.resample: Entire 900x900 tile to 448x448 by bilinear interpolation; identical map bounds for all views
input.label: Rasterize official building polygons directly on the 448x448 grid, pixel-center rule, preserve holes; valid empty FeatureCollections remain negatives
input.invalid: Zero-byte labels were excluded before selection. Do not infer nodata from black pixels. Nonfinite/nodata/geographic support must be shared across all four views.

model.name: torchvision fcn_resnet50
model.augmentation: Uniform D4 image/label joint transforms only
model.selection: Use epoch 30 for both seeds; no calibration-based checkpoint selection

loss.foreground_fraction: Equal mean of the foreground fraction within each of the 256 unique training masks, using each tile's four-view common valid mask; matches the image-average objective
loss.training: Per-image BCEWithLogits, true-class weights computed once from unique training masks, divide by valid pixel count, then average images
loss.evaluation: Same fixed weighted binary log loss, clip probabilities to [1e-6, 1-1e-6]
loss.fusion: Mean probabilities in common map coordinates; never mean logits or hard labels

secondary: Two-pass 0/90-degree TTA for A and B
Building foreground IoU at fixed 0.5 threshold
Constant 0.5 predictor (training-optimal constant for fixed balanced log loss)

statistics.order: Per tile and seed, then equal mean of tiles within each calibration block, equal mean of two seeds, equal mean of 16 blocks
statistics.bootstrap: PCG64(17017), 20000 paired block resamples, percentile 95% interval for the single primary quantity
statistics.secondary_intervals: Descriptive only; no simultaneous significance or journal claim
statistics.scope: Conditional on four acquisitions from one Atlanta pass; blocks and seeds do not create independent passes
